jyutping: daa2 baai6 N ni1 gin6 si6

english.note: Use this nominalizing construction to refer to the act of defeating N.

examples.english: The defeat of the opponent gave me a real sense of satisfaction.
examples.traditional: 打敗對手呢件事，令我好有滿足感。
